title: The Year the Web Exploded
narrative: Windows 95 ships with Internet Explorer. Netscape goes public and launches the dot-com gold rush. Java promises to make the web interactive. AltaVista makes the web searchable. GeoCities gives everyone a homepage. The internet stops being academic and starts being cultural.
